he.text: הִרְשַׁעְנוּ וּפָשַׁעְנוּ לָכֵן לֹא־נוֹשָׁעְנוּ׃ תֵּן בְּלִבֵּנוּ לַעֲזוֹב דֶּרֶךְ רֶשַׁע וְחוּשׁ לָנוּ יֶשַׁע · כַּכָּתוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶךָ יַעֲזֹב רָשָׁע דַּרְכּוֹ וְאִישׁ אָוֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָיו וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־יְיָ וִירַחֲמֵהוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּי־יַרְבֶּה לִסְלוֹחַ׃

en.text: We have done wickedly, we have transgressed, therefore we are not saved; our hearts are inclined to forsake the crooked and perverse way. O save us! as it is written, by the hand of thy prophet (Isaiah) “Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him, and to our God; for he will abundantly pardon.”
